g.text: OULAD: changed bins, unchanged records and KS
NATURAL OBSERVATIONAL COMPARISON; post-result correction. BBB 2013J reference → 2014J monitoring. Both statistics use exactly the same group records.
Minimum support 100; four of nine views qualify. Batch-50, batch-100 and accumulated-100 yield the same supported scores here. PSI and KS have
different scales. No drift onset, accuracy, significance or harm is established. The small original attempt PSI came from smoothing unequal sample
sizes across empty bins, not separation of attempt counts.
